title: Error on quarkus:dev after upgrade to 1.10.2.Final only with multiple persistence units
body:

**To Reproduce**
I can reproduce the issue easily by defining multiple persistence units in a new standalone project.

**Configuration**
```properties

quarkus.datasource.db-kind=mysql
quarkus.datasource.jdbc.url=jdbc:mysql://localhost:3306/xyz?useSSL=false&allowPublicKeyRetrieval=true
quarkus.datasource.username=root
quarkus.datasource.password=test123


# Quartz datasource
quarkus.datasource.quartz.db-kind=mysql
quarkus.datasource.quartz.jdbc.url=jdbc:mysql://localhost:3306/abc?useSSL=false&allowPublicKeyRetrieval=true&serverTimezone=UTC
quarkus.datasource.quartz.username=root
quarkus.datasource.quartz.password=test123

quarkus.hibernate-orm.database.generation=none
quarkus.hibernate-orm.packages=com.test.model

quarkus.hibernate-orm."system".datasource=quartz
quarkus.hibernate-orm."system".packages=com
```
